story_type: four boaters on a capsized racing catamaran, rescue boat throws a line, swimmer hauled aboard
hook: Their catamaran flipped mid race. Four people on the hull.
narration: Their catamaran flipped in bad weather, and all four people aboard climbed up onto the hull.
They had been racing in a sailboat regatta, from Gulfport, Mississippi to Pensacola, Florida.
At about four thirty in the afternoon, a personal locator beacon sent out a distress signal.
A forty five foot Coast Guard response boat from Station Dauphin Island found them.
[short pause] The crew threw a line across the water.
Rescue boats often keep clear of a flipped hull, because loose lines and rigging can wrap around a propeller.
So this boater swam to them in his life jacket.
Two crew members reached over the rail and hauled him up out of the Gulf.
outcome: The boat crew took all four boaters aboard, and no injuries were reported.
title: Catamaran flipped mid race, 4 on the hull
description:
On June 28, 2024, a 31-foot catamaran racing in a regatta from Gulfport, Mississippi to Pensacola, Florida capsized near Dauphin Island, Alabama. All four people aboard climbed onto the overturned hull, and a Coast Guard Station Dauphin Island boat crew took them aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Station Dauphin Island, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/929298/coast-guard-rescues-4-boaters-during-sailboat-regatta-near-dauphin-island-alabama
